mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and supporting equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.2% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% signals labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 7.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise >1% in same month but S&P 500 60-day returns negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change < 2.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL annual change < 2.0% but S&P 500 5-day returns negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth >0.5% in month but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >55% of months.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls growth exceeding 200,000 indicates strong job creation, supporting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increase >200,000 but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals policy response to economic weakness, preceding market rallies and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS falls and CPIAUCSL rises in same month but S&P 500 60-day returns negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth >2.5%) indicates economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 quarterly growth >2.5% but S&P 500 60-day returns negative in >50% of quarters.
